name: Maracas
summary: Pair of maracas with patterned heads and handles; anim shake rattles them. Use for Latin music or percussion scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the handle ends rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 the pair is about 520 px wide and 420 px tall

params.name: color
params.note: head colour of the left maraca (the right one is a contrasting colour)

params.name: accent
params.note: colour of the right maraca head and the dot pattern

params.name: anim
params.note: shake = the two maracas rattle up and down, out of step
